blockchain.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
blockchain.excerpt: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

blockchain.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
blockchain.excerpt: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

blockchain.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
blockchain.excerpt: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

blockchain.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
blockchain.excerpt: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
